description: Every tracked metric in one call: stablecoin, RWA, DeFi, L2, prediction-market, and agent-economy metrics, each with source, date, and confidence ($0.01 USDC per call). First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

name: get_all_metrics
